activity_summary: A tapster and a waterman got as far as the stair. Mistress Ansell would not have the manner of the news in the kitchen. Verbeke had heard a name in the lane and would not repeat it. You said there were three mouths and they would not match, and that you would not pay a penny to go. You were never going. You did not look at a bill. The Shrew was named as the company's afternoon, and you stayed in.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the versions over the bread, and said he was never going.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Stopped the manner at the mat, and would not add her neighbour's account.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Reported a name he would not repeat, and went back to the loom.

facets.activity: Stayed in on the day of the hanging

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not pay a penny to go and stand where it was done.
